import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, list them here
    ]

    # Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, select needed columns, and append to dfs
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # We only need 'Major_category' and 'Median' columns for the target
        # Some Median values might be missing, so keep them as float
        dfs.append(df[['Major_category', 'Median']])

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group by 'Major_category' and calculate the average Median
    result_df = combined_df.groupby('Major_category', as_index=False)['Median'].mean()

    # Sort by Major_category alphabetically (optional, for consistent output)
    result_df = result_df.sort_values('Major_category').reset_index(drop=True)

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_21/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
